ignoreCommand: if [ -z "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" ] || [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "main" ]; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://storage.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; media-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self';
